# Install
npm install -g clinic

# CPU profiling
clinic doctor -- node app.js

# Flame graph
clinic flame -- node app.js

# Bubble profiling
clinic bubbleprof -- node app.js

# Generate report
clinic doctor --collect-only -- node app.js
clinic doctor --visualize-only PID.clinic-doctor

// Start profiling
node --prof app.js

# Process the output
node --prof-process isolate-0x*.log > processed.txt

# Chrome DevTools
node --inspect app.js
# Open chrome://inspect

import cProfile
import pstats

# Profile a function
def main():
    # Your code here
    process_data()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    profiler = cProfile.Profile()
    profiler.enable()

    main()

    profiler.disable()
    stats = pstats.Stats(profiler)
    stats.sort_stats('cumulative')
    stats.print_stats(20)  # Top 20 functions

from memory_profiler import profile

@profile
def process_large_data():
    data = [i for i in range(1000000)]
    result = [x * 2 for x in data]
    return result

# Run with: python -m memory_profiler script.py

# CPU sampling (live process)
py-spy top --pid 12345

# Generate flame graph
py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid 12345

# Record for duration
py-spy record -o profile.svg --duration 60 -- python app.py

# CPU profile
curl http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30 > cpu.prof
go tool pprof cpu.prof

# Memory profile
curl http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > heap.prof
go tool pprof heap.prof

# Goroutine profile
curl http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/goroutine > goroutine.prof
go tool pprof goroutine.prof

# Web interface
go tool pprof -http=:8080 cpu.prof

# Start application with JMX
java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote \
     -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9010 \
     -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false \
     -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false \
     -jar app.jar

# Connect with VisualVM
jvisualvm

# CPU profiling
./profiler.sh -d 30 -f cpu.html <pid>

# Allocation profiling
./profiler.sh -d 30 -e alloc -f alloc.html <pid>

# Flame graph
./profiler.sh -d 30 -f flamegraph.svg <pid>
